0022600191.text: The New York Knicks (4-4, third in the Atlantic and 7th in the East) head to Cleveland on a two-game winning streak, while the Cavaliers (4-4, second in the Central and 6th in the East) are on a two-game losing streak. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury; he is averaging 8.6 points and 31.7 minutes this season, compared with 12.0 points and 30.2 minutes last season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 130-93 win in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
